tasks.label: Train Neural Bigram Model
args: from models.neural_bigram import NeuralBigramModel; from training.utils import create_sample_dataset; print('Training Neural Bigram Model...'); model = NeuralBigramModel(embedding_dim=8, hidden_dim=16); texts = create_sample_dataset(); model.train(texts, epochs=50, lr=0.1); print('Training complete! Generating samples:'); for i in range(3): print(f'Sample {i+1}: {model.generate(max_length=50)}')
